name: mnemonic_self_fragmenter
label: The Echo Carver
godotFeature: Custom Resources, SubViewport, GPUParticles3D, Custom Shaders
poeticVision: The player wields a weapon fueled not by ammunition, but by Lyra's very past. Each devastating shot carves a fragment directly from her recovered memories, or from the core of her identity itself. The screen briefly flickers with a ghostly image – a face, a place, a moment – before it's consumed, its essence repurposed into raw kinetic force against the Silence. This isn't just a cost; it's a deliberate act of self-mutilation for survival, forcing the player to confront the tragic paradox: how much of Lyra can be sacrificed before there’s nothing left to save? The feeling is one of desperate, self-destructive power, where every victory is also a profound, irreversible loss.
usage: This script defines a custom resource 'MemoryFragment'. Create new resources of this type (e.g., 'res://mem_joy.tres') and fill in its properties (name, texture, narrative tag, power, debuff effect, and duration). These resources will be assigned to the 'EchoCarver' weapon's 'memory_pool' array.

parameters.name: fragment_name
parameters.description: A descriptive name for the memory fragment.

parameters.name: texture
parameters.description: The visual representation of this memory, used for the consumption effect and particle infusion.

parameters.name: narrative_tag
parameters.description: A tag describing the memory's nature (e.g., 'Childhood Joy', 'Agility').

parameters.name: power_value
parameters.description: The base power contribution this memory provides to the weapon's projectile.

parameters.name: debuff_effect
parameters.description: A string identifier for the debuff applied to Lyra upon consuming this memory (e.g., 'reduce_speed').

parameters.name: debuff_duration
parameters.description: The duration in seconds for which the 'debuff_effect' is active.

verdict: The Echo Carver transmutes the agony of self-loss into a weapon of desperate survival, forging an unforgettable paradox where every shot fired erases a piece of the soul it fights to protect.
impact: This mechanic transforms memory loss from a narrative device into a visceral, agonizing gameplay choice. Players will constantly weigh immediate survival against the irreversible erosion of Lyra's identity, creating a deeply personal and unforgettable struggle where every victory carries the bitter taste of self-sacrifice. It elevates the core theme of identity dissolution into a core gameplay loop, forcing players to embody Lyra's tragic dilemma.
